verdict.rationale: Gumroad's pricing page says it acts as merchant of record and 'handles ALL your tax obligations' for global sales automatically, and a codebase review found TaxJar, Vatstack and IRAS tax integrations. However, an independent user report says Gumroad's merchant-of-record tax charges were rolled out before the feature was finished and were applied globally, including in regions with no tax to collect, which contradicts the claim that the correct tax is charged on every transaction. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how sales tax, VAT and GST are calculated per jurisdiction, and independent confirmation that tax is applied correctly.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically
